title: Krea 2 Turbo, put a person in a scene
description: Puts the person from one photo into another picture, keeping the scene and the person's likeness, with Krea 2 Turbo and the Krea 2 Identity Edit V2 LoRA in 8 steps: the scene is the first reference, aligned (kept as it is), the person the second, placed beside the output with reference boost 3, as the LoRA's model card suggests. Say where the person stands, how much of them shows and what they wear. The sample pictures and the preview were made with Fugue. Licences: the Edit LoRAs (V2) are free for personal and non-commercial use only; commercial use needs a licence from their author (https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/blob/main/LICENSE_V2.md), and the Krea 2 Community License applies on top (commercial use only under USD 1 M yearly revenue; deployments must filter content; https://krea.ai/krea-2-licensing).
